important_limits: Source response numbers are not parsed or summarized; 1279 records have all seven required fields present but are NOT numeric-code-valid Haldane rates.
Original author code excludes missing values, zero SDs, CV<0.1% or CV>1000%; those checks require numeric response opening and can reduce final eligible sample.
Source species and study roles remain fixed from the 70-species block-disjoint role authority; no re-splitting to rescue.
Source code selected Haldane per-generation SD-standardized unit prospectively for mixed trait types; no alternative Darwin-rate fallback if H is non-evaluable.
This is source-field admissibility, not demonstration of local adaptation, reaction-norm plasticity, genetic fitness advantage, speciation or any historical predictor effect.
